name: smart-connections-bridge
description: Node CLI bridge (sc-bridge) for reading Smart Connections's local .smart-env/multi/*.ajson vector index. Provides three ops — index-status, semantic-search, find-related — using bge-micro-v2 cosine similarity via @xenova/transformers. v0.1.0 SCAFFOLD: skeleton arg parser + stub op handlers; real implementation lands in S6.
